description: The plot illustrates how MRR@10 varies with the number of queries used during inference (S) for several DPR variants, with multiple colored lines and horizontal dashed reference lines. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale spanning 1 to 10, with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.5. A gray solid horizontal line labeled “DPR w/o query” sits near 34.25 across all S values. A yellow solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ gold” starts near 33.0 at S=4 and increases steadily to about 34.95 at S=10. A green solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ top-1” rises from about 33.0 at S=1 to about 34.7 at S=2, then continues upward to roughly 36.4 by S=10, with intermediate points around 35.45 at S=4 and about 36.1 at S=7. A purple solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ bottom-1” is around 34.75 at S=1, increases to about 35.05 at S=3, then trends downward and fluctuates slightly, ending near 34.7 at S=10. A blue solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ random” increases from about 34.75 at S=1 to about 35.25 at S=3, then stays near 35.2–35.3 through S=10, ending around 35.3. A red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ curriculum” increases from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2, then remains near 35.6–35.8 through S=10, ending around 35.75. Three dashed horizontal reference lines appear: a red dashed line near 35.6, a blue dashed line near 34.9, and a green dashed line near 34.65, each extending across the full x-range.
